https://www.rarejob.com/englishlab/column/20160702/
No. 9 from this link
*Subsituting with an existing motion is fine. Leaving it to you.

You can totally ignore the pose prompts.
What should I do today? Since I'm with you, Trainer, let's just do the usual.

Right~? Same here, honestly. I was too worried
about you to really get into it.

I mean, studying is super boring, right?
You just want effortless, fun stuff constantly popping up on your feed.
Like this~. Easy, right?

It certainly wasn't a vibe I was used to. But that was just because
I hadn't settled into it yet; the hangout itself felt fresh and fun.
...You're seriously weird, y'know that?

More than anything, I got to learn about the things Toosen Jordan liked.
I told her that was what really mattered, and it made me happy.

Got it? If your vibe ain't cute, your face won't look cute either.
Take that to heart and do it over! Chop-chop, let's go~!

I wanted to bridge the gap between myself and Toosen Jordan.
So I started looking into all sorts of recent trends, but...
...Like, this one totally killed my mood!

Like from friends, or on social media~. Funny stuff just keeps rolling in,
and while you're laughing, new stuff drops~. Get it?

Huh? Are you even trying?
Put some feeling into it! Think, "I am the ultimate cutie♪"

...I said 'not really.'
It's not like I said it was boring or anything.

There were a lot of trends I wasn't used to, and I struggled to keep up.
There was no point in faking it, so I shared my honest thoughts...
Wait, why?

It's impossible. We can't laugh at the same stuff.
So seriously, you don't gotta force yourself to study what I like anymore.

I didn't like it at all, and it felt like a total waste of time, but...
I can't just let my own Trainer keep totally bombing out there, y'know~?

I might not be book-smart, but I'm not stupid.
I get what you're trying to do. Don't push yourself, okay~?

I mean, your face was totally stiff~.
You looked totally lost, y'know?

Ugh, stop taking notes, that's so cringe.
...Can't believe you're spending your precious day off on this.

...I mean, I guess?
Though if you wanna know trends, there are way easier ways.

I'm just saying, it made things pretty obvious~.
We're completely different. Like, from different planets~?

So, how was today? This is literally what I do all the time.
Just chill, mess around, scroll through my phone, and chat~.

Just 'cause you're my trainer doesn't mean you gotta match my vibe.
You can still coach me even if you don't get any of this stuff.

So what you do is, burn the design into your memory~,
and go hunt down a cheap dupe later.

Huh~? Why are you laughing harder now than all day?! So gross!
Return that for me, will ya? Later!! Thanks for the frappé!
—Wait, why are you here?

I'm your runner and I'm right in my prime, hello~?
Guess I got no choice. I'll show ya how we hang out~.

And with that, I had Toosen Jordan show me
how she normally spent her free time—

...Man, it's been ages since I rented a DVD. Seriously, what a pain.
Next time... make sure it's something on streaming, okay?

No waaaaay, no chance~~~~. If I try it on, I'll just want it.
That brand is way too pricey. Totally out of my allowance budget~.

...It felt like the distance between Toosen Jordan and myself
had closed, just a little bit.

"I got your face memorized, punk~!"
...Like that~, ahahaha!

Go with orange eyeshadow~, layer on some duochrome glitter~.
Fill in with white eyeliner. Curl those lashes all the way up, then pink mascara~!

...Be real with me though~,
you thought it was totally boring, right?

First off, purikura while the hair and makeup look fresh.
It's a whole different vibe from phone filters, so we gotta get these too.

Huuuh~? Shouldn't you be saying 'make me look hot'?
Not that I've got the skills for it anyway. ...Maybe I'll give you a unibrow.
...Come on, crack a smile. Let's go~.
...Even though your face was totally stiff?

Hmm, checking out trends, huh...?
Isn't that stuff all about just going with the flow?

—Ooh, that top is so cute~!
I've been wanting an oversized one~. It's cheap too, totally buying it♪

Inside the bag she roughly tossed to me was a rented DVD
of the show "Bakushou Derby" that I had recommended to her before.

—Hmm~... Tough call~. Trainer, are you cool-toned? Warm-toned?
I got no clue. Whatever, as long as you look cute, right?

And so, a surprisingly enthusiastic Toosen Jordan
took it upon herself to show me 'how they hang out'—

—Hmm... Ooh, that top is super cute~.
The cropped look is so nice~. Adorbs.

—Thanks for the treat! Ah~, frappés are the absolute best~.
The new flavors here never miss.
